projects.label: Cloud Projects
projects.description: Reads and changes your projects, budgets and quota requests from a script or a CI job.

page.title: API Tokens
page.intro: An API token authenticates a script, a CI job or a device without a browser login. It carries your identity and nothing more — what it may do is decided per request, so a token can only narrow your rights, never widen them. Send it as <1>{{header}}</1>; it is shown once, when it is created, and only its hash is stored.
page.noApiMessage: This deployment has neither the DNS nor the Cloud Projects API configured, so there is nothing to issue a token for.

mcp.title: Use with an AI assistant (MCP)
mcp.intro: This API speaks the <1>Model Context Protocol</1>, so an assistant can read and change your {{subject}} for you. It acts as you and can do nothing you could not do yourself — a read-only token gives it a read-only assistant.
mcp.hint: The greyed-out lines are where it goes — copying takes only the entry, so it drops in next to the servers you already have. Replace <1>{{placeholder}}</1> with a token from the table above; a token is shown in full only once, when it is created, and the entry offered there already has it filled in.
